# Images

Drop the real firm assets here. The build copies this folder to `dist/assets/img/`.

| File | Used where | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `kyle-hindin.jpg` | Hero (desktop) | Kyle in the hero. 4:5 portrait, ≥ 960×1200, under 150 KB. Until it exists the hero shows a dark placeholder block (no broken image). |

The white logo lives one level up at `assets/logo-white.svg`. The file shipped there is a text wordmark placeholder. Replace it with the firm's actual white logo, keeping the filename.
